name: HandsOn VR
description: Add-on for Vivecraft that makes the inventory feel like a native VR game: physical holsters (right shoulder and hips), a backpack on your left shoulder (inventory pages, 2x2 crafting, armor and a drop zone, no screen), a radial hotbar on B/X, an immersive crafting table (place items on the 3x3 grid on top of the table, grab the floating result), and grip-to-borrow items that return when you let go. Client-side only.
